en: A vintage black-and-white photograph of a naval warship with three smokestacks, identified as 'Minentransportschiff Jenissei.' The ship is sailing at sea with smoke billowing from its stacks. There are handwritten Russian annotations on the lower part of the postcard and printed German text beneath the image. The flag at the back suggests it is from the Russian Imperial Navy. The card's corners feature a decorative leafy design.
